name: Bitwarden Lite
description: Bitwarden Lite bundles the Bitwarden self-host server (admin, api, identity, icons, notifications) and web vault behind nginx. Not an official Bitwarden script - built by extracting the published ghcr.io/bitwarden/* images and running them as systemd services, since Bitwarden Lite has no native install path.

app_vars.name: BW_INSTALL_EMAIL
app_vars.label: Installation Email
app_vars.help: Registers a new installation id/key automatically. Leave blank to enter an existing id/key instead.

app_vars.name: BW_INSTALLATION_ID
app_vars.label: Installation ID
app_vars.help: Only used if Installation Email is blank. From https://bitwarden.com/host/, can be set later in bitwarden.env

app_vars.name: BW_INSTALLATION_KEY
app_vars.label: Installation Key
app_vars.help: Only used if Installation Email is blank. From https://bitwarden.com/host/, can be set later in bitwarden.env

notes.text: Not an official Bitwarden script. Bitwarden Lite has no native install path, so this extracts the published ghcr.io/bitwarden/* container images with skopeo (no Docker daemon) and runs each service under systemd.
MS SQL Server has no official Debian repository. This installs it from Microsoft's Ubuntu 22.04 repo on the Debian container as a best-effort, unofficial workaround, amd64 only.
The core services need a real installation ID and key from https://bitwarden.com/host/ to fully function. Set them in /opt/bitwarden/bitwarden.env and run 'bitwarden-reconfigure'.
